MCSS-Lite 0.2.0

Build UI from declared parts.

MCSS-Lite is a pure-CSS design system where every class, state and token is written down in a contract. People and AI agents read the same contract, and mcss-lite validate rejects any part that isn't in it.

npm install @gabrielpule/mcss-lite
  • AGENTS.md: the rules for agents
  • Manifest: every part as JSON
  • Figma variables
  • Source on GitHub

1

Step 1: Lay the baseplate

Layout primitives own all spacing. Components never set their own outer margin, so any part fits anywhere.

New parts, 1:1

  • l-sectionModifiers --sm
  • l-containerModifiers --narrow
  • l-stackModifiers --sm --lg
  • l-center
  • l-sidebarElements __sidebar __content
  • l-switcher

2

Step 2: Seat the buttons in a cluster

l-cluster lines parts up in a row that wraps. Primary goes last; destructive actions get the danger brick.

New parts, 1:1

  • l-cluster
  • c-buttonModifiers --primary --secondary --ghost --danger --sm --lgStates data-state="disabled" data-state="loading"

Step 3: Snap on the badges

Step 4: Place cards on the grid

This piece doesn't fit

An agent guessed a class. npx mcss-lite validate rejects it and names the parts that do exist. This output was produced by the real validator when this page was built.

Invented markup

<button class="c-button c-button--warning" data-state="error">Retry</button>

validate

  • error Unknown class "c-button--warning". Valid modifiers of c-button: --primary, --secondary, --ghost, --danger, --sm, --lg. Only classes from the MCSS-Lite contracts exist. [unknown-class]
  • error data-state="error" is not a state of c-button (allowed: c-button: disabled, loading). [invalid-state]

The piece that fits

<button type="button" class="c-button c-button--danger">Retry</button>

Generated from components/*.json and demo/steps.json by npm run build, so this page can't drift from the contract.
